title: 第十八章 匕首第十九章 龙腾小队
lines: 第十八章匕首
匕首是叶欢之前找黄德平要的，100把精钢匕首，经过叶欢重新用灵火炼制。
他还在上面刻制了禁制，锋利无比，削铁如泥，可以说是地球上最强的神兵利器。
所以，叶欢说是这是他送给这群特种兵的礼物！
叶欢没想到的是，后来这些匕首在龙腾的手中大放异彩。
匕首，也成为了传奇。
许多年之后，仍然有人来龙安森林，企图寻找匕首。
龙腾匕首，成为龙安森林里埋葬的宝物，就像江湖中的倚天屠龙，是无数军人心中的神器。
甚至，那些武者都渴望拥有一把龙腾的匕首。
汪涛，被叶欢放倒的50名特种兵精英之一，同样是特种兵中的精英。
他修炼刻苦，比所有人都狠，成为了北山军区最强的几人之一。
能够让他服气的，也就这就只有蔡鹏飞和王聪几人而已。
现在，又多了一个，不止是服气，是佩服，是敬仰。
他这么刻苦，是有原因的，他有一个不得不让自己变强的理由。
他的女朋友，被一个黑道大佬的儿子抢走，他去报警，反倒被警察抓了起来，在监狱里狠狠教训了一顿。
是他的女朋友，拼死相救，他才没有在监狱里变成报废。
他要报仇，加入了军队，成为了特种兵，成为了精英。
但距离报仇，依旧是遥遥无期，然而这个仇，却像是梦魇，时时刻刻督促着他努力，刻苦。
现在，机会来了，他亲眼见过叶欢的恐怖，一个单挑了50个特种兵，其中还有铁腿蔡鹏飞！
所以，他要抓住这个机会，拼死也要抓住这个机会，这是他报仇的唯一希望。
转眼一天一夜过去，已经有人取得了匕首，却没有人抢夺。
大家都是战友，下不了手，而且，很多人怀疑叶欢本领，也不是很想让叶欢当他们教官。
消息会不断通知这些人，已经拿回了多少匕首，当拿回30把以后，剩下的人就被淘汰，全部返回。
渐渐的，大家都摸清了一些规矩，这个教官放的匕首，都是在一些极其危险的地方。
湖底，蛇窝，树顶……甚至是一些野兽的身上，也不知道这个教官到底是怎么放到这些地方的。
要找到这些匕首，不仅需要实力，细心，最关键的，还需要一点运气。
龙安森林太大了，要找到这些匕首谈何容易！
“已经有20把匕首被送回，各位特种兵请抓紧时间……”
汪涛心头焦急万分，他十分渴望拜入叶欢名下，只有这样，他才有机会报仇。
别人不知道教官的强大，他知道，所以他比别人都拼命。
可是要找到教官藏的匕首，不仅仅是努力还需要运气。
汪涛一拳重重地打在一个树木身上，他比所有人都渴望，都拼命，为什么，就是找不到匕首！
“已经有25把匕首被送回，请各位……”对讲机的声音又在汪涛耳朵里响起。
汪涛要疯了！
这个机会，他绝对不能错过，只要不死，拼命也要拜在叶欢名下。
可是，没有时间了！
这时，不远处，一位特种兵走过。
他手里，正好拿着叶欢的匕首。
汪涛冲了过去，拦在了那人面前。

Chapter 18 Dagger
The daggers were obtained by Ye Huan from Huang Deping before. They were 100 fine steel daggers that were refined by Ye Huan using spiritual fire.
He also carved a restriction on it, which is extremely sharp and can cut iron like clay. It can be said to be the most powerful magical weapon on earth.
Therefore, Ye Huan said that this was his gift to these special forces soldiers!
What Ye Huan didn't expect was that these daggers would shine in Long Teng's hands.
The dagger has also become a legend.
Many years later, people still come to Long'an Forest, trying to find the dagger.
The Longteng Dagger has become a treasure buried in the Long'an Forest, just like the Heaven Slaying Dragon in the Jianghu, and it is an artifact in the hearts of countless soldiers.
Even those warriors longed to own a Soaring Dragon's dagger.
…
Wang Tao, one of the 50 special forces elites brought down by Ye Huan, is also an elite among the special forces.
He practiced hard and was more ruthless than everyone else, becoming one of the strongest people in the Beishan Military Region.
The only people who could convince him were Cai Pengfei and Wang Cong.
Now, there is one more person who is not only convinced, but also admired and admired.
There is a reason why he works so hard. He has a reason why he has to make himself stronger.
His girlfriend was snatched away by the son of a mafia boss. He went to call the police, but was arrested by the police and was severely punished in prison.
It was his girlfriend who fought tooth and nail to save him from becoming a scrap in prison.
He wanted revenge, joined the army, became a special soldier, and became an elite.
But revenge is still far away, but this revenge is like a nightmare, urging him to work hard and work hard all the time.
Now, the opportunity came. He had seen Ye Huan's terror with his own eyes. He singled out 50 special forces soldiers, including Cai Pengfei with iron legs!
Therefore, he must seize this opportunity and fight to the death to seize this opportunity. This is his only hope for revenge.
In the blink of an eye, a day and a night passed. Someone had already obtained the dagger, but no one snatched it.
We were all comrades in arms and couldn't do anything. Moreover, many people doubted Ye Huan's abilities and didn't really want Ye Huan to be their instructor.
The message will continue to inform these people how many daggers have been retrieved. After 30 daggers are retrieved, the remaining people will be eliminated and all will be returned.
Gradually, everyone figured out some of the rules. The instructor placed the daggers in extremely dangerous places.
The bottom of the lake, the snake's nest, the top of the tree...even some beasts, I don't know how the instructor put them in these places.
To find these daggers, you not only need strength, care, and most importantly, a little luck.
Long'an Forest is so big that it's not easy to find these daggers!
"20 daggers have been sent back. Special forces soldiers, please hurry up..."
Wang Tao was extremely anxious. He was very eager to take Ye Huan's name. Only in this way could he have a chance to take revenge.
Others don't know how powerful the instructor is, but he knows it, so he works harder than others.
But to find the dagger hidden by the instructor, it takes not only hard work but also luck.
Wang Tao punched a tree hard. He wanted more than anyone else and worked hard. Why, he couldn't find the dagger!
"25 daggers have been sent back, please..." The voice of the intercom rang in Wang Tao's ears again.
Wang Tao is going crazy!
He must not miss this opportunity. As long as he doesn't die, he will work hard to be in Ye Huan's name.
But, there is no time!
At this time, not far away, a special soldier walked by.
In his hand, he happened to be holding Ye Huan's dagger.
Wang Tao rushed over and stopped in front of the man.
